tools.name: search_titles
tools.description: Find movies and series by title (Korean or English, typos tolerated). Returns StreamPick ids, release year and the Korean subscription services each title is on. Use the id with where_to_watch for prices and details.

tools.name: where_to_watch
tools.description: Where a movie or series can be watched in South Korea: subscription, rental and purchase services, the cheapest monthly plan or bundle (KRW), when the next episode airs, and a StreamPick link. Pass an id from search_titles, or a title.

tools.name: trending
tools.description: What is trending in South Korea right now by the StreamPick Korean Buzz score (Naver search trend and volume, YouTube views, TMDB popularity, recency). Optionally limit to one OTT service.

tools.name: new_releases
tools.description: Movies, series and new seasons released in South Korea in a given month, with the release date and the OTT services they are on. Covers the current month, past months back to 2026-10, and up to two months ahead.

tools.name: arrivals_and_departures
tools.description: Titles that recently arrived on or left Korean OTT subscription services, newest first. For departures, subscriptionPlatforms shows where the title can still be watched.

tools.name: cheapest_plan_for
tools.description: The cheapest set of Korean OTT subscriptions and bundles (KRW per month) that covers every title in a list, which service to watch each title on, and up to two alternatives. Pass StreamPick ids or titles.
